acceptanceCriteria: gateselect indexRepository scans files with bounded parallelism
Before/after medians at stated load are retained
body: Follow-up from the spike lane (2026-10-21, branch claude/batch-spike; the evidence is in docs/build-log/2026-10-21-*.md once that batch lands). V1-1880 measured repository indexing at a median of 1.289 s against 0.230 s for a raw walk (load about 66). corvint test --dry-run took 10.3-13.2 s at load 8. Sharing the reads with the affected Go graph is not recommended; parallelising gateselect scanFile is.
